 "We must put everything in place to rise to occasion," says Hemdani 
 AFCON 2027 Qualifiers
 "We must put everything in place to rise to occasion," says Hemdani
 Saturday, November 14, 2026 14:01 TIZI-OUZOU -The national team coach, Brahim Hemdani, expressed his ambition to see the "Greens" return to winning ways when they host Togo on Saturday at Hocine Aït-Ahmed stadium in Tizi-Ouzou (8:00 p.m.), on the occasion of the third matchday (Group I) of the 2027 AFCON qualifiers.
